newsitem.title: FINLAND: NO PICK-UP IN FINNISH 1996-97 CONSTRUCTION OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: NO PICK-UP IN FINNISH 1996-97 CONSTRUCTION OUTLOOK.

text.p: The Finnish construction sector expects construction volumes to remain almost unchanged in 1996 and 1997 compared to 1995, the Confederation of Finnish Construction Industries said in a statement on Monday.
"The construction industry expects construction to remain almost unchanged this year and next," the confederation said.
Volume growth forecasts for 1996 were in a 0-2 percent range. In 1995, housing starts fell by 8,500 to 18,300, it said.
"Growth forecasts for next year are overshadowed by the clear fall in industry's investment plans and great uncertainty about the start of housing construction," the lobby said.
